title: Homemade Soya - A Taste of Home
excerpt: My secret recipe for the most delicious homemade soya, fresh and straight from the kitchen.
content:
Bringing Cameroon to Your Kitchen

If you know, you know. Soya is more than just food - it is a memory, a feeling, a piece of home that travels with you wherever you go.

For those who do not know, soya is a beloved Cameroonian street food - seasoned, grilled meat on skewers that brings people together. And today, I am sharing how I make it right here at home.

What You Need

  • 2 lbs beef (or chicken), cut into bite-sized pieces
  • 2 tablespoons suya spice (or make your own blend)
  • 1 tablespoon groundnut powder
  • 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
  • Salt to taste
  • Onion powder
  • Garlic powder
  • Vegetable oil
  • Wooden skewers

How to Make It

  1. Mix all the dry spices together in a bowl
  2. Marinate the meat in the spice mix for at least 2 hours (overnight is even better)
  3. Thread the meat onto wooden skewers
  4. Grill on medium-high heat, turning every few minutes
  5. Brush with a little oil as you grill
  6. Serve hot with sliced onions and tomatoes

The secret is in the marination time. The longer you let those spices work their magic, the more flavorful your soya will be.

You can find most of these ingredients in African stores. Everything is here, trust me!
